headline: Medium and High-Tech Goods Drive 58% of Türkiye Free Zone Exports
summary: According to the Trade Ministry, medium- and high-tech products generated 58.4 percent of total exports across Türkiye's 19 free zones in the first nine months of 2026.
why: Free zones in Turkey serve as important manufacturing and export hubs for foreign trade and industrial development.

impacts.name: Turkish Manufacturing
impacts.why: A high share of technology-intensive exports highlights an upgrade in industrial export capabilities.
